title: Trinity test warning

tellings.quote: Trinity. They said, you know, we don't know what's going to happen. Put on your glasses and keep your head down.

plain: Before Trinity, the first atomic bomb test in New Mexico in 1945, the people watching were told that no one knew what was going to happen, so they should put on their glasses and keep their heads down. John S. Herrington, a former US Secretary of Energy, tells this on Michels' show and passes it on as coming from the physicist J. Robert Oppenheimer, who led the bomb project. The point of the story is that even the scientists did not know what they were about to unleash.
